newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha strong at new heights.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha strong at new heights.

text.p: NWE naphtha was strong again on Tuesday after an Alexandria cargo traded at a dizzy $216 cif NWE on Monday, the highest level in five years, traders said.
Business was quiet. "Everyone is scared to death of these numbers," one regular ARA buyer said. Swaps were $1 or $2 up.

The Indian Oil Corp. awarded two 25,000 tonne tendered cargoes, loading in Madras in early October, to a Swiss-based trader. The tender was heard awarded at $19 under fob NWE quotes and Asian dealers said they expected the cargoes to move to Europe or north America.
